text: As a child, Theo was fascinated by the stars and spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home. This love for astronomy was more than just a hobby; it was a bond with his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. She taught him that the night sky was not empty, but a canvas of stories written in light. Theo often looked up and imagined the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, wondering if those same clouds drifted past the constellations his mother loved. Her absence left a quiet void, but her legacy remained in every telescope he polished and every star chart he studied, driving him to seek answers in the cosmos that he could no longer find in her arms.
